I replied to Marcus in a thread in #north-team: the contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is Thea Ramaswell, their Director of Yard Operations.

That comes from two places Marcus can see himself. Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, morning shift. The North team cheat sheet, which is a public file, also lists Thea as QFL's main contact.

gbrain refused the search again for the same reason as before, so nothing came from it. The connection still isn't tied to any member, and the fix is the rescope command from my last report, run on the brain host.
